changelog:
VexZygisk v2.2.0

English

New
- HyperOS runtime support: modules registered through the spawner are told when an app is specialized
- The traces a revert cannot reach are hidden: the module libraries still mapped, and the mount line bionic keeps in one static buffer
- Zygisk Next in full: Dobby inline hooking, LSPlt pltHook, symbol resolution into .gnu_debugdata, and libraries handed over as sealed memfds
- Late load: the monitor starts from late-load.d and claims the zygote and the spawner that are already running, instead of waiting for the next fork

Changed
- arm64 only: the 32-bit build, the translator path only the 32-bit tracer could reach, and its SELinux rule are gone
- webview_zygote is switched into the clean namespace instead of being reverted in place
- Release builds keep no logs at all, and the binaries are held to a size budget

Fixed
- WebView and module WebUIs no longer break partway into a session
- An unknown manager app id is no longer read as a denylisted application
- An isolated process in a later user is recognised as one again, so Private Space no longer slips past the denylist
- The zygote no longer leaks one string allocation per process it spawns

简体中文

新增
- HyperOS Runtime 支持：通过 spawner 注册的模块会在应用特化时收到通知
- 回滚够不到的痕迹会被隐藏：仍映射着的模块库，以及 bionic 留在单个静态缓冲里的挂载行
- Zygisk Next 完整支持：Dobby inline hook、LSPlt pltHook、符号解析扩展到 .gnu_debugdata、模块库以密封 memfd 交付
- Late load：monitor 从 late-load.d 启动，并直接接管已在运行的 zygote 与 spawner，而不是等待下一次 fork

变更
- 仅 arm64：32 位构建、只有 32 位 tracer 能到达的翻译器路径及其 SELinux 规则一并移除
- webview_zygote 改为切换到干净命名空间，不再就地回滚
- release 构建完全不保留日志，二进制体积受预算约束

修复
- WebView 与模块 WebUI 不再在会话中途损坏
- 未知的管理器 app id 不再被当成被列入黑名单的应用
- 后续用户下的隔离进程重新被识别为隔离进程，Private Space 不再绕过黑名单
- zygote 不再为它拉起的每个进程泄漏一次字符串分配
